# Iconify v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir library for working with Iconify icons

## Pages

- [Iconify](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Iconify](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/Iconify.md): Elixir library for working with Iconify icons.
- [Iconify.Fetcher](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/Iconify.Fetcher.md): Fetches icon data from Iconify sources.
- [Iconify.Icon](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/Iconify.Icon.md): Represents a single normalized Iconify icon.

- [Iconify.SVG](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/Iconify.SVG.md): SVG rendering utilities for Iconify icons.

- [Iconify.Set](https://iconify.hexdocs.pm/Iconify.Set.md): Represents an Iconify icon set (collection of icons with a common prefix).
